title: Long cycle from minimum degree
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph whose minimum degree $\delta(G)$ is at least $2$. Then $G$ contains a cycle of length at least $\delta(G) + 1$.
replaced:
(starred). \emph{If \texttt{G} is simple and \texttt{$\delta$ $\ge$ 2}, then \texttt{G}
contains a cycle of length at least \texttt{$\delta$ + 1}.}
